thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty fired -> IN-7021 embeddings-eu queue-backpressure. tags: region=eu, service=embedder, symptom=redis-sentinel-failover :rotating_light: PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/IN-7021

devon: i'm on call, taking this one. pulling cluster metrics and logs now.

maria: quick metrics dump from grafana:
```
queue_depth(embedder)=1240 (baseline ~120)
5xx_rate=6.4%
connection_errors=spike -> redis-sentinel failover events observed at 2024-07-02T14:12Z
affected_pods=embedder-eu-*
```

ryan: tagging edge/support: @kate heads-up — some EU customers may see failures on large batched embeddings. i'll prep a support note after we know scope.

sophie: infra check: redis-sentinel saw repeated leader election -> master restarted twice in 2m. clients hit connection refused and retried, saturating connection pool. investigating host-level IO and network flaps.

devon: Claiming the page (PD ack). short plan: (1) gate large-batch requests at gateway (ryan) (2) reduce embedder concurrency to lower file/socket pressure (maria) (3) stabilize redis-sentinel by cordoning node and forcing healthy leader (sophie) (4) scale embedder horizontally if queue doesn't drain (devon)

maria: lowering embedder worker concurrency from 16 -> 8 for eu pods, rolling restart in progress. should reduce simultaneous redis connections.

ryan: applying gateway rule: reject >50k token batch payloads with 429 and add header X-RW-Throttle: true for routed ones. setting 30m window. will post rollback message.

sophie: performed leader fencing for sentinel, moved master to eu-redis-02 which has stable disk and network. no more elections in the last 30s. also bumped sentinel timeouts to reduce flapping sensitivity.

maria: per-pod queue length now dropping ~20% after concurrency change. no more connection refused logs in embedder pods.

devon: PD note: claimed and coordinating. estimated customer impact: intermittent 5xx for large batches in EU, single-item embedding calls unaffected. will update every 5m.

ryan: drafted PSA for kate review. it summarizes affected endpoints, mitigation steps, and expected timeline.

kate: draft looks good, hold for final perf confirmation before send. will stand ready to post.

sophie: follow-up: created INF-2025 to track permanent fixes: sentinel config hardening, alert on leader elections, and connection pool backpressure handling in embedder clients.

maria: queue depth normalized to ~90 within 8 minutes after concurrency change and leader stabilization. 5xx rate down to 0.8% in last minute.

devon: good progress. leaving page claimed and moving to monitoring for 20m. if stable, we'll resolve PD and publish post-incident notes referencing INF-2025.

ryan: PSA sent to affected customers just now. support channel informed.

kate: seeing a couple of inbound tickets, but all are accounted for and routed to ops.

devon: update +16m: metrics stable, no new sentinel elections, 5xx < 0.5%. resolving PD in 5. keeping watch for 30m then will close thread.

maria: adding timeline and logs to incident doc; linking INF-2025 in notes.

incidentbot: incident IN-7021 marked mitigated by devon at 3138002134. monitoring window active until 3138003934.
